title: SpongeBob in the Ruins
description: SpongeBob SquarePants stands triumphantly on a stone pillar in a stormy, gothic ruin landscape, wearing a black wizard robe with red sash. He raises both arms with index fingers pointing up, smiling widely, surrounded by floating photos of dancing characters, purple tentacles, green slime, and speech bubbles saying 'PARTY IN THE RUINS!' and an octopus drawing, all set against crashing waves, lightning, and a dark ruined cathedral.
